idea-plugin.name: Kuk Dev Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Charcoal themes with a lime accent for JetBrains IDEs, inspired by Kuk, the Egyptian god of primordial darkness. A companion to NYX Dev Themes.

Flat #151517 surfaces, a darker gutter, bright file tree and an editor color scheme tuned to match each UI theme. Solid light folders in the Project view; on Neon, Ember and Abyss the selected row takes the accent color and its text and icons turn dark.

Included themes

  • Kuk — sky-blue keywords, pale lime types, soft yellow strings and lilac calls.
  • Kuk Neon — pink keywords, yellow types, peach strings and a lime selected row.
  • Kuk Ember — rose-red accent, pink keywords, coral types and warm sand strings.
  • Kuk Abyss — ocean-blue accent, blue keywords, cyan types and aqua strings.

How to use

Go to Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance and pick a Kuk theme. The matching editor scheme is applied automatically; if not, select it under Editor → Color Scheme.

Free and open source. If Kuk makes your code feel better, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
